title: Detailed helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main rotor blades -->
  <rect x='8' y='13' width='84' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='8' y='13' width='84' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='4' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='1.5' fill='#ff7b66'/>
  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='18' width='6' height='10' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <!-- tail rotor shaft -->
  <rect x='84' y='38' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M78 34 L94 34 L94 46 L82 46 Z' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <path d='M80 37 L91 37 L91 43 L82 43 Z' fill='#ff9b8a'/>
  <!-- tail rotor on fin -->
  <rect x='86' y='27' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='32' ry='17' fill='#2980b9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='26' ry='11' fill='#54a8de'/>
  <!-- cockpit glass -->
  <path d='M26 46 Q34 36 48 38 L48 52 Q34 54 26 46 Z' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <path d='M30 45 Q36 39 45 40 L45 49 Q36 50 30 45 Z' fill='#eaffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='51' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- skid landing gear -->
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='34' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='34' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#c39bdc'/>
  <rect x='36' y='58' width='3' height='8' fill='#7d3c98'/>
  <rect x='55' y='58' width='3' height='8' fill='#7d3c98'/>
  <!-- side window -->
  <rect x='54' y='42' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='44' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#eaffff'/>
  <!-- swirl detail -->
  <path d='M58 56 Q64 60 70 56' stroke='#bff0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little eye on nose (cute) -->
  <circle cx='21' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#fff'/>
</svg>
